hints.title: Jump Feasibility Condition
hints.text: A transition from index i to j requires j > i and nums[j] >= nums[i].

hints.title: Quadratic Cost Accumulation
hints.text: Accumulate transition costs as the squared difference between indices.

hints.title: DP State Relaxation
hints.text: Relax target indices in forward order to find the minimum arrival cost at the final index.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
